# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
import re

note_content = note['content']
lines = note_content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('- '):
            line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and artists part
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artists_part = parts[1].replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})

print(f"Found {len(songs_todo)} songs with TODO")
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s)

# Now let's build the updated note content with release months
from datetime import datetime

# Create a mapping from song title to release month/year
release_months = {}
for song in songs_todo:
    date_str = release_dates[song['title']]
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(date_str)
    release_months[song['title']] = f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year}"

# Update the note content line by line
new_lines = []
for line in note_content.split('\n'):
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Find which song this line corresponds to
        # Extract the title part (before " BY ")
        title_part = line.split(' BY ')[0].lstrip('- ').strip()
        # Find the song in songs_todo by matching title
        for song in songs_todo:
            if song['title'] == title_part:
                month_year = release_months[song['title']]
                line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {month_year}')
                break
    new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
